name: Monke Horror
summary:
😱 MAPS 😱
Monke Horror is a terrifying VR game where you and your friends explore the eerie and decayed facility with flickering lights and unsettling sounds. Each area hides new dangers, keeping you on edge as you search for a way to escape.

👻 MONSTERS 👻
Lurking in the shadows are relentless creatures that stalk your every move. Some are fast, some are cunning, and others wait patiently for the perfect moment to strike. They see, hear, and hunt—so stay out of sight, keep quiet, and don’t let them catch
